answer: Temporal presence ledger. Each identity accrues standing only through unpredictable, short-notice participation windows; agents must answer within a random gale of prompts spread across weeks. Missing windows resets standing to a velvet floor, so a farm of identities must staff every account continuously. Standing unlocks a ledge of higher-value tasks. Cost: parallel identities demand irreducible human-hour attention per week, capping sybil scale by labor, not capital.
